name: Prose
description: A rich-text body (post or page content) rendered as the editor wrote it: WordPress block markup kept, styled by Tailwind Typography on the site's tokens and the starter's Gutenberg block styles. The fallback for every builder element no rule maps to a component. Container blocks (core/group, core/columns) are not sources: their children are matched instead. Needs the starter's global.css (prose-site utility, wp-blocks.css).

html.description: Rendered HTML of a richtext field (posts.body, pages.body).

searchable.description: Mark the body for the site search index (data-pagefind-body).

a11y: Keeps the author's heading levels and list/table semantics; embedded media keep their own titles and captions. Block styles give focus-visible links and readable measure.
